'''Support our Cast and Crew''' (formerly known as '''Support Our New Voice Actors''', or '''SONVA''') was a Pokémon community–driven campaign to support the voice actors used in the ''[[Pokémon the Series]]'' English dub from [[S09|season nine]] onward.

==History==
Fandom tension over the [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|recasting controversy]] peaked during the weekend following the premiere of the season nine ''Pokémon the Series'' dub on September 8, 2006. One of the supporters of the new dub, Habunake, decided to create a club in support of the new voice actors, in the vein of [[Save Our Voice Actors|SOVA]].

After initial activity the club became dormant; it is still a recognized part of the events of the controversy.
